name: haus
author: Haus contributors
description: Haus apps, home services and shared packages

scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @haus/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @haus/state typecheck && pnpm --filter @haus/mobile typecheck && pnpm --filter @haus/media typecheck && pnpm --filter @haus/bridge typecheck && pnpm --filter @haus/homekit typecheck && pnpm --filter @haus/desktop typecheck && tsc --noEmit
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm architecture:check && pnpm format:check && pnpm test && pnpm check:apps
scripts.check:apps: pnpm build:services && pnpm --filter @haus/homekit test && pnpm --filter haus-nvr check && HAUS_HELPER_PATH=$PWD/apps/helper/haus-helper pnpm --filter haus-nvr test:integration && pnpm --filter haus-helper check
